guards.new-event: A fresh event ID records the operation; it differs from the prior event.
guards.evidence: At least one nonempty evidence reference is supplied.
guards.new-evidence: Evidence includes a reference absent from the previous version.
guards.authority: The invoking agent supplies the resolved correction/deletion authority.
guards.reason: A concise reason explains the change.
guards.reviewed: The agent has reviewed admission and its evidence.
guards.replacement: An active, different replacement version explicitly names the original version and preserves applicability.
guards.new-version: The replacement version number increases while retaining the record ID.
guards.expiry-reached: The known exclusive valid-until boundary has been reached.

current-predicate.meaning: Resolved project scope is authorized for this operation.
Current time is at or after valid-from and strictly before valid-until, when known.
Trust meets the explicit operation threshold, independently of confidence.
The record is visible rather than explicitly omitted from current assembly.
The observed bank has no active superseding record for this version.
